Rajasthan local body polls see 32 unopposed chairpersons elected

In the Rajasthan local body polls, 32 chairpersons have been elected unopposed. These elections were for civic body positions, including Mayors and Chairpersons. The results indicate a lack of contest in these specific seats across the state.
